description: Detailed image properties inspector with collapsible sections for the picture (URL and caption), size and rotation with aspect lock, text wrapping, position (alignment, X/Y, anchor lock), z-order, and accessibility (alt text, decorative). Dispatches changes debounced. Every editing control renders only when its callback (AltTextChanged, DecorativeChanged, ToggleCaption/CaptionChanged, UrlChanged, SizeChanged, WrapModeChanged, AlignmentChanged, PositionChanged, LockAnchorChanged, BringForward, SendBackward) is bound; an unbound callback hides the control (an unbound URL falls back to the read-only source line).

parameters.name: Image
parameters.description: Image content displayed by the inspector.

parameters.name: AlignmentChanged
parameters.description: Raised when alignment changes. The control renders only when this callback is bound.

parameters.name: AltTextChanged
parameters.description: Raised when alternative text changes. The control renders only when this callback is bound.

parameters.name: BringForward
parameters.description: Raised when the image should move one layer forward. The control renders only when this callback is bound.

parameters.name: CaptionChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the image caption text changes. The control renders only when this callback is bound.

parameters.name: DecorativeChanged
parameters.description: Raised when decorative image mode changes. The control renders only when this callback is bound.

parameters.name: LockAnchorChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the object anchor lock changes. The control renders only when this callback is bound.

parameters.name: PositionChanged
parameters.description: Raised when image object position offsets change. The control renders only when this callback is bound.

parameters.name: SendBackward
parameters.description: Raised when the image should move one layer backward. The control renders only when this callback is bound.

parameters.name: SizeChanged
parameters.description: Raised when image size changes. The control renders only when this callback is bound.

parameters.name: ToggleCaption
parameters.description: Raised when the caption should be toggled. The control renders only when this callback is bound.

parameters.name: UrlChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the source URL of an URL-backed image changes. The control renders only when this callback is bound.

parameters.name: WrapModeChanged
parameters.description: Raised when text wrapping mode changes. The control renders only when this callback is bound.
